limitations: Native Chiriboga AI-vs-AI only; no new Chrome or human playtests in this benchmark.
Only two seeds per identity pairing and lineup combination; no claim of tournament strength or human balance.
Same seed labels do not imply identical hands because deck sizes and contents differ.
Official lists are baselines, not guaranteed optimal lists or current Standard tournament-legal decks.
Opening probabilities exclude mulligans, extra draw, accesses and card effects. Taxing/damage ice is distinct from run-stopping ice.
Static runner breaker availability excludes tutors, Botulus, click breaks, derez and other ways to access; it is not a run failure probability.

dispositions.precision-design-v1: High opening-consistency priority: compare a 44-card, 15-ice revision with cheap code gates, draw/selection and burst economy. Bot wins alone did not establish an overall improvement; preserve bioroid scoring identity.
dispositions.restoring-humanity-v1: High priority: more cheap ice/draw and lower agenda-card density; test official ambush/damage structure rather than simply adding generic ice.
dispositions.reality-plus-v1: High opening-consistency priority: 11 ice and no Whitespace. Test cheap defense/draw changes without automatically replacing the tag-destruction package: current NBN won more paired bot games than its reference.
dispositions.built-to-last-v2: Keep revised early-defense option for now; compare 44-card agenda suite and draw/economy with official operation-heavy archetype before another change.
dispositions.loup-v1: No low-ice analogue; compare fewer redundant breakers with Cookbook, DZMZ, Docklands and Carnivore support. Current list is not proven weak by ratios alone.
dispositions.zahya-v1: Runner revision priority: dedicated draw is thin; compare VRcation, Pennyshaver and multiaccess package while retaining tutor access. The reference also won more paired bot games.
dispositions.tao-v1: Lower priority: basic economy/draw counts already comparable; test Mayfly bridge and identity/rig support before changing.
